questions.prompt: Thanksgiving is here — and the parade just got pushed to Saturday, so the morning's big opening act is off-script. Tonight, which scene sounds most like yours?

options.text: All in anyway — the parade can wait, the day is happening and I'm here for all of it.
Slowing the morning down — coffee, nowhere to be, the day can find its own pace.
Rallying the house — turning the delay into the first story of the day.
Quiet in the corner — the day's a lot already and I need a minute before it starts.

questions.prompt: Silksong's first expansion details land tomorrow — the reveal is a day away and the wait is doing its thing. Tonight, how are you holding the countdown?

options.text: Already buzzing — refreshing the feed, the reveal can't come fast enough.
Steady — it'll be there tomorrow, I'm in no rush to get there first.
Spinning on it — builds, bosses, what ifs, my head's running ahead of the news.
Tuning it out tonight — I'll catch the reveal when it's actually here.

questions.prompt: Vice City has a new trick to learn — how to get the adrenaline pumping in GTA 6, and everyone's chasing the rush. Tonight, what do you do when the rush is right there?

options.text: Chasing it — full speed, the rush is the whole point tonight.
Showing the crew — look what I just pulled off, then we all try it.
Playing it careful — my ride stays shiny, the rush can wait its turn.
In over my head — the city's moving faster than I can keep up.

questions.prompt: Blade Runner 2099 is here — the reviews are in, the rain-soaked neon world is back, and tonight's the night you settle in to watch it. If someone handled the table tonight, what would you want on it?

options.text: The full spread — snacks stacked, the neon night deserves a proper table.
Something to toast with — sparkling cider or champagne, virgin or hard, the premiere deserves it.
A warm mug of tea or cocoa — slow sips while the rain falls on screen.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: All eight episodes of Rings of Power Season 3 are ranked now — the season's done, and everyone's arguing about which one ruled. Tonight, which sound of that season is your vibe?

options.text: The episode that went biggest — horns, drums, the whole battle.
The big reveal's theme — the moment the season turned, turned up loud.
The quiet episode's strings — soft, warm, the one that stayed with you.
None of them tonight — my own quiet, the debate can wait.

questions.prompt: The Black Friday glow-up deals are live — your place could look different by the weekend, and the wishlist is staring back at you. In the hour ahead, what does your hunt feel like?

options.text: Measuring the room — the lamp, the shelf, the glow-up is already taking shape.
Already picturing it — the place lit up, the deal locked in, the weekend's going to feel different.
Stuck between three versions — every pick changes the whole room and I can't choose.
Leaving the room as-is — the glow-up can wait, I like it fine tonight.
